## Corrected Core Pattern

```go
func (c *Cache) Get(ctx context.Context, key string) (interface{}, error) {
    c.mu.Lock()
    entry, ok := c.data[key]
    if ok && time.Now().Before(entry.ExpiresAt) && !entry.Loading {
        c.mu.Unlock()
        atomic.AddInt64(&c.stats.Hits, 1)
        return entry.Value, nil
    }
    
    if ok && entry.Loading {
        ch := entry.ready // Use channel, not busy-wait
        c.mu.Unlock()
        select {
        case <-ch:
            return c.Get(ctx, key) // Retry
        case <-ctx.Done():
            return nil, ctx.Err()
        }
    }
    
    ready := make(chan struct{})
    c.data[key] = &CacheEntry{Loading: true, ready: ready}
    c.mu.Unlock()
    // ... load, then close(ready) to wake waiters
}
```
